FirstnameLastnameAge
JillSmith50
' print(md(html)) ``` The table should begin with: ``` | Firstname | Lastname | Age | | --- | --- | --- | | Jill | Smith | 50 | ``` The current output inserts an empty header and its separator before the Firstname row.
